title: Interim Accounts Payable
company: Hays Accounts and Finance - Agency - Temporary
description:
About the Company

This organisation is a well-established public sector body responsible for managing and maintaining significant environmental and land-based assets across England. With a strong focus on sustainability, conservation, and community engagement, they play a key role in supporting both environmental objectives and public access initiatives.They offer a collaborative and purpose-driven working environment, where employees are encouraged to contribute to meaningful work while developing their professional skills within a supportive team.

About the Role

Due to ongoing demand within the finance function, our client is looking to recruit an Accounts Payable Assistant to join their established transactional finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals looking to build on their existing experience within a structured and high-performing environment.You will be responsible for supporting the end-to-end accounts payable process, ensuring that all supplier transactions are handled accurately, efficiently, and in line with internal procedures.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Monitoring and prioritising the finance inbox, ensuring queries and invoices are dealt with promptly.
- Processing a high volume of supplier invoices, including accurate coding, VAT treatment, and matching to purchase orders.
- Liaising with budget holders to obtain timely invoice approvals.
- Processing authorised invoices for payment within agreed timeframes.
- Reconciling supplier statements and investigating any discrepancies.
- Setting up new supplier accounts in line with company policies and procedures.
- Responding to supplier queries in a professional and efficient manner.
- Liaising with internal teams and external stakeholders to maintain a high standard of service delivery.
- Providing ad hoc administrative and financial support to the wider finance team as required.

This role will suit someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment with a varied workload.

What You Will Need to Succeed

To be successful in this role, you will:
- Have previous experience in an Accounts Payable or transactional finance position.
- Possess strong attention to detail and accuracy when processing financial data.
- Have a good understanding of invoice processing, reconciliations, and VAT principles.
- Be highly organised, with the ability to prioritise workload effectively.
- Demonstrate strong communication skills and the ability to build relationships with stakeholders.
- Have a proactive and professional approach to resolving queries.
- Be comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
- Experience with finance systems and Microsoft Excel would be advantageous.

Details

Hourly Rate: 16.18/hour premium

Hybrid Working: Initially in 5 days a week to settle in, then hybrid working with 2 days in office

Length of Assignment: December 2026

Location: BS16 1 EJ

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant
- Location: Bath
- Job Type: Part-time (22.5 hours per week)
- Salary: £30,000 p.a. pro rata

We are seeking an Accounts Assistant to join our family run business. This role is crucial in supporting the Financial Controller with a range of financial tasks including Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) activities and general financial administration. This position is ideal for someone who is organised, reliable, and proactive, and thrives in a small, dynamic team environment.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Accounts Payable (AP): Process supplier invoices with accurate coding and approval, maintain the AP ledger, ensure timely payment runs, and reconcile supplier statements.
- Accounts Receivable (AR): Assist in checking and approving tenant invoices, be the first point of contact for credit control, maintain the AR ledger, and update tenant accounts.
- Banking & Reconciliation: Perform daily bank reconciliations, post financial entries, and manage tenant deposit accounts.
- Service Charge & Property Management Support: Assist in the reconciliations of service charge budgets, maintain property-related financial records, and liaise with property managers, suppliers, and tenants regarding finance-related queries.
- Month-End & Reporting: Prepare control account reconciliations, assist with month-end processes, and prepare reports for management and stakeholders.
- General Finance Administration: Maintain digital filing systems, assist with finance-related tasks and projects, and support the Financial Controller with additional duties.
- General Office Tasks: Assist with general office administration including managing staff refreshments, handling post, and answering calls.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Experience in an Accounts Assistant or Finance Assistant role.
- Strong understanding of Accounts Payable and/or Accounts Receivable processes.
- Excellent numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel.
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks.
- Excellent communication skills.

Desirable:
- Experience in property management or real estate finance.
- Knowledge of service charge accounting.
- Familiarity with property management or accounting software (e.g., Xero, ApprovalMax, Re-Leased).

Personal Attributes:
- Proactive and organised, comfortable with varied tasks.
- Reliable and trustworthy with strong ownership of duties.
- Inquisitive nature, actively seeking improvement opportunities.
- Collaborative with a "can-do" attitude.

Benefits:
- Competitive pro rata salary.
- Flexible working hours across 3-5 days.
- Opportunity to work in a dynamic and supportive team environment.
- Involvement in varied and impactful financial tasks.

To apply for the Accounts Assistant position, please submit your CV and cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in this role.
